Page guide: what this page does

Source: R/guide.R
kit_tab_guide.Rd

A one-line guide at the top of each tab, collapsed by default: only the sentence "這一頁做什麼：" ("What this page does:") is visible, with "看步驟 ▸" ("See steps ▸") next to it; opening it shows the steps, what you get, additional notes, and technical notes. No border, small gray text, a light line below.

Usage

kit_tab_guide(
  goal,
  steps,
  output,
  technical = NULL,
  note = NULL,
  diagram = NULL
)

Arguments

goal

One sentence, no more than 30 characters.

steps

The steps to follow: kit_steps() (3–6 points), or a character vector (turned into kit_steps() automatically).

output

What you get.

technical

Technical notes (for people who want to know how it works; collapsed one more level); NULL shows nothing.

note

Additional notes (small gray text); NULL shows nothing.

diagram

A diagram (kit_diagram()): placed outside the guide box, right after it, and visible even when the guide is collapsed; NULL shows nothing.

Value

Without a diagram, <details class="kit-guide kit-guide-page">; with a diagram, it is wrapped in <div class="kit-guide kit-guide-wrap">.

See also

kit_steps(), kit_diagram()

Examples

kit_tab_guide(
  goal = "把多個波次的檔案依 ID 接成一張寬資料。",
  steps = kit_steps("選要串接的檔案", "選 ID 欄", "按「執行串接」"),
  output = "一張寬資料，可以下載 CSV、SAV。"
)
#> <details class="kit-guide kit-guide-page">
#>   <summary>
#>     <strong>這一頁做什麼：</strong>
#>     把多個波次的檔案依 ID 接成一張寬資料。
#>     <span class="kit-guide-more"></span>
#>   </summary>
#>   <div class="kit-guide-body">
#>     <div>
#>       <strong>步驟：</strong>
#>       <ol class="kit-steps">
#>         <li>選要串接的檔案</li>
#>         <li>選 ID 欄</li>
#>         <li>按「執行串接」</li>
#>       </ol>
#>     </div>
#>     <p>
#>       <strong>會得到：</strong>
#>       一張寬資料，可以下載 CSV、SAV。
#>     </p>
#>   </div>
#> </details>
